descriptions.cc43b_clamp_position_802852c4: Clamp each position coordinate to the original external minimum and maximum by reference-returning comparisons, preserving the original comparison order, aliasing and NaN behavior. Copy all three original float components before stores and return whether any of their three 32-bit representations changed, preserving signed zero and NaN payload distinctions. Partial observed owner view at +32; full original type and sizeof unknown. Bounds remain unowned original externals.
